thread:
Sam W: FYI — Acme Biologics just flagged invoice 2026-07-15 (INV-2026-0715-AC). They say a Q3 promo wasn’t applied and tax looks off. Can finance ops do a manual adj?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0715-AC generated 2026-07-15 09:12Z. Total: $18,452.34. Payment status: posted. PDF link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0715-AC

Jess P: Can you paste the invoice line items here (or a small CSV)? need to see how promo was applied.

Sam W: pasted CSV:
```
account,description,qty,unit,unit_price,discount_promo,tax_rate,line_total
ACME-123,LLM tokens - usage,1,1,22000.00,-5000.00,0.087,14845.00
ACME-123,Support surcharge,1,1,500.00,0.00,0.087,543.50
ACME-123,Promo PROMO-Q3 applied to usage only,-,,-5000.00,-5000.00,0.00,-5000.00
```
Looks like promo was subtracted before tax on usage line, but support surcharge still taxed at full rate. Customer expected promo to reduce taxable base (we should have applied promo across taxable components).

Maya (CS): Customer says sales promised 50% promo on usage+support for the Q3 trial (promo code PROMO-Q3). Contract note: "PROMO-Q3 covers eligible charges up to $15k" — looks like billing applied to usage only. Customer is asking for credit and corrected tax.

Carlos: Sales confirmed PROMO-Q3 approval on 2026-06-20 (see internal approval thread). It should have applied to invoice components that are taxable. Does finance want a one-off goodwill credit plus tax correction?

Jess P: Quick calc: subtotal before promo = 22,500.00 (usage 22,000 + support 500). Promo eligible = up to 15,000 but we applied only 5,000 to usage. Correct application should have been -11,250 (50% of 22,500) but cap is 15k so 11,250 applies. Taxable base then = 22,500 - 11,250 = 11,250. Tax @8.7% = 978.75. New total should be 11,250 + 978.75 = 12,228.75. Current posted total 18,452.34, delta = 6,223.59 credit required.

Jess P: Proposal: issue manual credit memo = -6,223.59 (includes tax adjustment). Use manual adj code FIN-MAN-2026-089 and set reason: PROMO misapplied (PROMO-Q3), customer goodwill. Need Dir Finance sign-off to post credit to a posted invoice.

Priya (Dir Finance): @Jess P I approve the manual credit for Acme. Confirm credit memo reference and GL impact please.

Jess P: Will post CM-2026-1425 for -$6,223.59 today. GL: Revenue Contra 4010; Tax Liability 2410 adjustment. Notes: Customer credited due to promo misapplication; document FIN-MAN-2026-089 attached.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-1425 created and applied to INV-2026-0715-AC. New balance: $0.00. Credit posted 2026-07-16 14:30Z. Reference FIN-MAN-2026-089.

Maya (CS): Thanks — told the customer they’ll see the corrected invoice and refund (if any) in 3-5 business days. They asked for a short note we can send — attaching a brief template to the case. :thumbsup:

Sam W: great, closing thread. Please update the promo application test in billing QA so this doesn’t recur (we should have unit test for promo coverage across taxable components).

Jess P: Adding an entry to billing incidents tracker and assigning to eng-billing for a fix. Ticket BI-2026-315.

Carlos: Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.
